ANNOUNCE.template:
ANNOUNCE rtsp://example.com/stream RTSP/1.0
CSeq: 8
Content-Type: application/sdp
Content-Length: ...

DESCRIBE.template:
DESCRIBE rtsp://example.com/stream RTSP/1.0
CSeq: 2
Accept: application/sdp

OPTIONS.template:
OPTIONS rtsp://example.com RTSP/1.0
CSeq: 1
User-Agent: ClientName

PLAY.template:
PLAY rtsp://example.com/stream RTSP/1.0
CSeq: 4
Session: 12345678
Range: npt=0-

RECORD.template:
RECORD rtsp://example.com/stream RTSP/1.0
CSeq: 9
Session: 12345678
Range: npt=0-

REDIRECT.template:
RTSP/1.0 301 Moved Permanently
CSeq: 10
Location: rtsp://newserver.com/stream

SETUP.template:
SETUP rtsp://example.com/stream/track1 RTSP/1.0
CSeq: 3
Transport: RTP/AVP;unicast;client_port=4588-4589

SET_PARAMETER.template:
SET_PARAMETER rtsp://example.com/stream RTSP/1.0
CSeq: 11
Session: 12345678
Content-Length: ...
